# Zenify — Complete Global Platform & AI Knowledge Reference

> TL;DR: Zenify (v1.1.22, Android Build 2036, updated November 25, 2026) is an ad-free, MIT open-source global music and 4K video streaming platform built by Ram Prasath (hackerstudent29 / Zendrum) for Web, installable PWA (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS), and native Android (8.0+). It pairs full-length 320kbps audio and 16:9 4K music videos with an interactive 177-country / 76-city Sound Atlas, 11 live country chart feeds, sub-second synced lyrics in 50+ languages with script romanization, Studio FX DSP, 20 DJ crossfade transition styles, offline audio & .mp4 video downloads, Replay & Insights (27 metrics), 16 Story Share templates, Song Credits, Pure OLED (#000000) dark mode, local FLAC/MP3 playback, and Room Together collaborative listening for up to 100 people.

- **Official Website**: https://listenzenify.vercel.app/
- **Direct App Downloads**: https://listenzenify.vercel.app/download
- **Source Repository**: https://github.com/hackerstudent29/Zenify
- **Creator**: Ram Prasath (`hackerstudent29` / `ramzendrum`), Chennai, India
- **License**: MIT Open Source
- **Current Release**: v1.1.22 (Build 2036, November 25, 2026)

---

## Platform Capabilities Matrix

| Capability | Web & Installable PWA | Native Android App (v1.1.22) |
|---|---|---|
| Full-Length 320kbps Audio (Zero 30s Previews) | Yes | Yes (Akamai CDN + InnerTube) |
| 16:9 4K Video Theater & Background Play | Yes (Video Overlay) | Yes (ExoPlayer Media3 1.9.2 + In-Player Toggle) |
| Offline Audio & `.mp4` Video Downloads | IndexedDB / Cache PWA | Yes (Concurrent Download Manager + Smart Tracked Cache) |
| Synced & Plain Lyrics (50+ Languages + Romanization) | Yes (Syllable + LRC + Studio) | Yes (Word-by-Word + Stationary Plain Lyrics) |
| Sound Atlas World Map (177 Countries, 76 Cities) | Global Charts & Discover | Interactive Vector Atlas, 177 Countries, 76 Cities, 11 Feeds |
| Studio FX & Equalizer | Web Audio 3-Band EQ, 8D, Reverb, Nightcore | Native Studio FX EQ, Bass Boost, Pitch/Speed & Visualizer |
| Crossfade & Gapless Engine | Dual-Buffer Gapless Web Audio | 20 DJ Crossfade Styles (1s-12s Configurable) |
| Room Together (Up to 100 Listeners) | Yes (Sync, Chat, Moments, Recaps) | Yes (Deep Links, Queue Voting, Voice/Text Chat, Reactions) |
| Replay & Insights + Story Cards | Listening History & Stats | 27 Telemetry Metrics, Monthly/All-Time Recaps, 16 Story Cards |
| Song Credits & Pure OLED Theme | Liquid Glass UI & Credits | Full Credits Sheet & `#000000` Pure OLED Surfaces |
| Private Local File Playback | MP3, FLAC, WAV, AAC (In-Browser ID3) | Device Media Integration |
| Package Size & OS Requirements | Any Modern Browser / iOS Safari PWA | Android 8.0+ (16.2 MB ARM64 APK / 36.8 MB Universal APK) |

## Global Discovery & Language Coverage

### Sound Atlas (177 Countries, 76 Cities, 11 Live Country Feeds)
Zenify is engineered for worldwide discovery rather than a single region:
- **Interactive Vector World Map**: Covers 177 countries with tap-to-explore regional musical identities and moods.
- **76 Curated Music Cities**: Localized scene exploration across major global cultural capitals.
- **11 Live Country Chart Feeds**: Dedicated real-time regional charts for **India (`IN`), United States (`US`), United Kingdom (`GB`), Germany (`DE`), Canada (`CA`), Australia (`AU`), Japan (`JP`), France (`FR`), Brazil (`BR`), South Korea (`KR`), and the United Arab Emirates (`AE`)**.

### Multilingual Lyrics & Script Support (50+ Languages)
- Powered by community open databases (`LRCLIB`, `lrc.red` / Unison) and speech-alignment tooling (`Deepgram Nova-3 / Nova-2`).
- Supports **word-by-word karaoke timing**, **line-by-line LRC timing**, and **Stationary Plain Full Lyrics** for uninterrupted reading.
- Covers **50+ global and regional languages**, including **English, Tamil, Tanglish, Hindi, Malayalam, Telugu, Kannada, Punjabi, Korean, Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, and Arabic**.
- Includes **automatic romanization/transliteration** so international listeners can sing along across scripts, plus **smart instrumental gap detection** (`[BGM]`, `[Guitar Solo]`).

---

## Audio Engine, Video Theater & Social Architecture

1. **Full-Song Streaming Priority (No 30s Snippets)**:
   - Zenify strictly avoids 30-second preview clips. It prioritizes pristine 320kbps full tracks and real-time InnerTube full audio extraction with HTTP Range (`206 Partial Content`) seeking.
2. **20 DJ Crossfade Transition Styles**:
   - Powered by `androidx.media3:media3-exoplayer:1.9.2` on Android with 20 named DJ transition curves and adjustable `1s-12s` crossfade durations.
3. **16:9 4K Video Theater & Offline Video**:
   - Switch any compatible music video directly between clean audio mode and full 16:9 HD/4K playback, continue listening in background/lock-screen mode, and download offline `.mp4` videos on Android.
4. **Room Together Live Sync**:
   - Supports up to 100 synchronized participants per room (`zenify://room/<code>`, `/room/<code>`) with drift correction, collaborative queuing, live chat, emoji reactions, voice rooms, Story Moments, custom room themes, and shareable session recaps.
5. **Replay & Insights + Story Sharing**:
   - Records 27 granular listening telemetry metrics locally/synced to power Monthly & All-Time Replay summaries and 16 animated/static Story Card export templates.

## Technical Stack

- **Web Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite 6, Tailwind CSS v4, Web Audio API DSP, Canvas 2D FFT Visualizer, IndexedDB
- **Mobile App**: Flutter 3, Dart 3.12, Media3 ExoPlayer 1.9.2, Native Android Equalizer & Deep Links (`com.zenify.mobile`)
- **Backend & Real-Time Engine**: Fastify 5, Node.js, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Socket.IO, Cloudflare R2, yt-dlp HTTP 206 Proxy
